title: Measurement
description: The execution or application of a Metric to a particular subject, within a defined context, using an identified measurement method and applicable configuration. A Measurement is distinct from the Metric it applies and from the MeasurementObservation it produces. (CR-MET-001 binding ADR-MET-002; full attribute set in CR-MET-003.)

applies_metric.description: Reference to the dea:PerformanceMetric definition version applied. Cardinality 1:1 (every Measurement applies exactly one Metric). The reference MAY include the semantic version (e.g. dea:metric-customer-retention-rate@1.0.0). (CR-MET-003 binding ADR-MET-002 decision 6.)

measures_subject.description: Reference to the entity that was measured. Cardinality 1:1 (every Measurement targets one subject). Current source list (7 entity types) matches the dea:measured-by source endpoint; CR-MET-007 widens to 17 per ADR-MET-004. (CR-MET-003 binding ADR-MET-002 decision 7.)

measurement_method.description: Method applied to perform the measurement (CR-MET-003 binding). Required.

measurement_time.description: Time of measurement execution or capture (CR-MET-003 binding). Required.

reporting_period_start.description: Start of the reporting period represented by the measurement. Conditional on the parent Metric having a reporting-period concept; full binding in CR-MET-006.

reporting_period_end.description: End of the reporting period represented by the measurement. Conditional on the parent Metric having a reporting-period concept; full binding in CR-MET-006.

measurement_source.description: Data source or originating system. Recommended.

measurement_status.description: Execution or record status (CR-MET-003 binding). The 10-value enum is the canonical Measurement lifecycle; CR-MET-004 refines it. Required.

evidence_reference.description: Supporting evidence references. Each reference is a string handle that the future governance / evidence CRs will resolve. Recommended.

temporal.description: Temporal context placeholder. Full specification in CR-MET-004 (lifecycle) and CR-MET-011 (temporal dimensions).

responsible_party.description: Reference to the responsible party. Full governance object spec in CR-MET-010.

configuration.description: Configuration parameters necessary to reproduce the result. Full specification in CR-MET-003.
